title: UnitedHealth Stock News (Oct 15, 2026): UNH Rises 4.7% to $395.62
summary: UNH closed at $395.62 on Oct 14, up 4.73%, as UnitedHealth extended gains after Q3 results beat estimates and it raised its 2026 outlook.
body_markdown:
## Why UnitedHealth Stock Rose


According to the company's[third-quarter 2026 earnings release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000731766/000073176626000255/earningsrelease3q26unh.htm) filed with the SEC on October 13, 2026, UnitedHealth Group earned $4.69 per share on an adjusted basis on revenue of $112.7 billion, and raised its full-year 2026 outlook to adjusted earnings of at least $20.50 per share.


The medical care ratio improved to 88.4% from 89.9% a year earlier, and CEO Stephen Hemsley said the results "reflect the discipline and execution our teams are bringing to every part of our business."


Per[Zacks](https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/unh-q3-earnings-call-highlights-130000419.html) , the adjusted figure compared with a consensus estimate of $4.12, and CFO Wayne DeVeydt said the low end of the company's 13% to 16% long-term earnings growth target is a reasonable starting point for 2027. As reported by[StockStory](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/stocks-making-big-moves-yesterday-172407906.html) , the shares rose after the[third-quarter results](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/bank-earnings-week-kicks-off-jpmorgan-unitedhealth-custodian-banks/) topped expectations and lifted the profit outlook.


The rally came one session late. According to[24/7 Wall St.](https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/unitedhealth-down-big-over-3-164522640.html) , the stock closed down 0.23% on earnings day after opening higher, as investors weighed the beat against shrinking membership.


## UNH Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Optum Health's third-quarter operating earnings rose to $735 million from $41 million a year earlier, according to Zacks.
- The operating cost ratio fell to 12.8% from 13.5%, and cash flow from operations reached $5.1 billion, per the SEC filing.
- Management plans to give a fuller 2027 outlook before year-end, according to Zacks.


### Risks


- UnitedHealthcare served 48.3 million members, down from 50.1 million a year earlier, and Medicare Advantage has lost 935,000 members this year, per 24/7 Wall St.
- 24/7 Wall St. noted that $610 million of favorable prior-period reserve development helped the medical care ratio improve, a boost that may not repeat.
- Commercial medical cost trends remain above the company's initial 11% expectation, driven by specialty drugs and clinician costs, according to Zacks.
- Justice Department actions tied to its Medicare business and CMS Star Ratings remain open risks, per 24/7 Wall St.
